# Transaction API


## Description

- This Transaction API is a simulation API designed to create, list, and retrieve successful payment transaction records. Also, this API supports full CRUD operations for User and Product models.


## Framework

* Django REST Framework


## Models

* User(django default)
* Product
  * uid : The unique ID of a product generated by a user-defined function, `generate_uid`
  * name
  * price
* Transaction
  * user: Foreign Key(Refers to the `User` model)
  * product: Foreign Key(Refers to the `Product` model)
  * tx_at: The date and time the transaction is made
  * payment_method: Choice Field(0: DEBIT / 1: CREDIT / 2: CASH)


## CRUD

* User model
  * Create(`/api/users/`):
    * Permission: AllowAny
  * Read - List(`/api/users/`):
    * Permission: IsAdminUser(Only user whose 'is_staff' is set can see the list of users)
  * Read - Retrieve(`/api/users/<int:pk>/`):
    * Permission: IsOwner(Only owners of the accounts can see their own User records)
  * Update(`/api/users/<int:pk>/`)
    * Permission: IsOwner(Only owners of the accounts can update their own User records)
  * Delete(`/api/users/<int:pk>/`)
    * Permission: IsOwner(Only owners of the accounts can delete their own accounts)
  
* Product model
  * Create(`/api/products/`)
    * Permission: IsAdminUser(Only staffs can create a new product)
  * Read - List(`/api/products/`)
    * Permission: AllowAny
  * Read - Retrieve(`/api/products/<int:pk>/`)
    * Permission: AllowAny
  * Update(`/api/products/<int:pk>/`)
    * Permission: IsAdminUser(Only staffs can update the products)
  * Delete(`/api/products/<int:pk>/`)
    * Permission: IsAdminUser(Only staffs can delete the products)

* Transaction model
  * Create(`/api/transactions/`)
    * Permission: IsAuthenticated
    * Validation: The requesting `user` must match the `user` specified in the transaction request.
  * Read - List(`/api/transactions/`)
    * Permission: IsAuthenticated
    * Validation: Staffs can see the list of all transactions. And general users only can see the list of their own transactions history.
  * Read - Retrieve(`/api/transactions/`)
    * Permission: IsAuthenticated
    * Staffs can see any transactions. And general users only can see their own transaction record.
